name: Voidborn
summary: 4.4 Voidborn Born aboard a voidship, orbital station, warship, pilgrim vessel, or ancient wreck. Allowed Species: Human, Ratling, rare Ogryn. Skill Proficiency: Choose one from Acrobatics, Perception, Investigation, or Technology. Void Legs: You have advantage on checks and saving throws to avoid being knocked prone or moved against your will. Shipwise: You are proficient with basic voidship procedures, airlocks, auspex consoles, pressure doors, and shipboard emergency systems.
